25.steps:
1) Configure Remote Gateway with the selection  Local network obtains IP addresses using DHCP through this VPN Tunnel  in the VPN policy.
  2) Open DHCP over VPN Configuration window on the VPN > DHCP over VPN page on the Remote Gateway and enter Relay IP address.
  3) Go to Devices tab and push the Add button under Excluded LAN Devices header.
  4) In the Add Excluded LAN Entry dialog, enter the Ethernet address of the PC on Remote network in the Ethernet Address field. Save.
  5) Configure Central Gateway with the selection  Destination network obtains IP addresses using DHCP through this VPN Tunnel? in the VPN policy.
  6) Run ipconfig/renew command on the DHCP Client.
25.title: Excluded LAN devices, add.
25.result:
Negotiation doesn't start.
  The client doesn't have a lease.

27.steps:
1) Have the Ethernet address of the PC on Remote network entered in Excluded LAN devices table in DHCP over VPN Configure dialog on Remote Gateway. Make sure that the PC cannot obtain a DHCP lease through VPN.
  2) Open the DHCP over VPN Configure dialog on Remote Gateway and go to Devices tab. Select the excluded entry and push the Del ete button. Select OK button in the following message.
  3) Run ipconfig/renew command on the PC on Remote Network.
27.title: Excluded LAN devices, delete.
27.result:
The excluded entry is removed from DHCP over VPN Configure dialog on Remote Gateway.
  Negotiation starts when DHCP request is sent from the PC. The tunnel is established. The PC obtains a lease through the VPN tunnel.

1.steps:
PC1(dhcp client)---(LAN 192.168.3.1)X0 FW1 X1(WAN 10.8.105.183)---(WAN 10.8.54.46)X1 FW2 X0(LAN 192.168.54.1)---PC2(DHCP Server 192.168.54.9)
  1) Configure Remote Gateway. 1. Add a VPN policy on the firewall. choose main mode or aggressive mode 2. Select the Local network obtains IP addresses using DHCP through this VPN Tunnel radio button under Local Networks. 3. Select the Choose destination network from list option and select the address object Central Net (LAN subnet 192.168.54.0 on the Central site ) under Destination Networks. 4. Check the HTTP /HTTPS check boxes for Management via this SA in the Advanced tab. 2) Open DHCP over VPN Configuration window on the VPN > DHCP over VPN page on the Remote Gateway and set parameters. Enter Relay IP address and Management IP address. Those addresses must belong to the scope of LAN addresses of the Peer Gateway network.
  for example: peer gateway(LAN)192.168.54.0. you can input Relay IP to 192.168.54.30, Managment IP to 192.168.54.40.
  3) Configure Central Gateway. 1. Add a VPN policy on the firewall. choose main mode or aggressive mode 2. Select the Choose destination network from list option and select the address object LAN Primary Subnet under Local Networks. 3. Select the Destination network obtains IP addresses using DHCP through this VPN Tunnel radio button under Destination Networks. 4) Open DHCP over VPN Configuration window on the VPN > DHCP over VPN page on the Central Gateway and set parameters. Check on checkbox of "Send DHCP requests to the server addresses listed below" and add the IP address of external DHCP server (host:192.168.54.9. pool:192.168.3.60-70).
  5) Configure the external DHCP server on the LAN of Central Gateway. Set the pool of addresses available for leasing.
  6) Change the network configuration properties on the PC connected to the LAN of Remote Gateway to obtain IP address automatically (dhcp mode).
  7) Send pings from the PC (DHCP Client) to a host on the LAN of Central Gateway(ping 192.168.54.9).
  8) Manage Remote Gateway from the Central network. Set the address in the browser to the Management IP and access Remote Gateway. Login as administrator.(from host 192.168.54.9 access to https://192.168.54.40)
1.title: External server is used, Relay IP is specified on Remote Gateway, Management IP is set. Client obtains a lease.
1.result: 1. Remote Gateway is set automatically on the VPN > DHCP over VPN page when the Local network obtains IP addresses using DHCP through this VPN Tunnel radio button under Local Networks is selected in the VPN policy on Remote Gateway. 2. Current DHCP over VPN Leases table on Remote Gateway shows Relay IP and Management IP static entries. 3. The access rules for LAN to VPN and VPN to LAN on Remote Gateway show Vpn DHCP Clients and Central Net address objects. 4. The access rules for LAN to VPN and VPN to LAN on Central Gateway show LAN Primary Subnet and Vpn DHCP Clients address objects. 5. When the network configuration properties on the PC on the Remote site changed to dhcp mode, IKE negotiation is initiated by Remote Gateway and DHCP broadcast packets are passed through the tunnel. Ipconfig command returns the IP address obtained from the external DHCP server on the Central site. 6. Current DHCP over VPN Leases table on Remote Gateway is populated with a new entry. It shows IP address, computer name, and Ethernet address of the DHCP Client. The table is sent to Central Gateway upon negotiation. 7. Current DHCP over VPN Leases table on Central Gateway shows three entries: Relay IP, Management IP, and DHCP Client. 8. The message under the table on Remote and Central Gateways shows: The number of Dynamic: 1, Static: 2, Total: 3. 9. Log message on Central Gateway shows DHCP lease is relayed to remote device message. Source: the DHCP server's address, destination Relay IP (that is specified on Remote Gateway). 10. Log message on Remote Gateway shows DHCP lease relayed to local devicemessage. Source :the DHCP server's address, destination ,Relay IP address (specified on Remote Gateway). 11. Pings from the DHCP client to the host on Central network are returned. Remote Gateway can be accessed from Central site when the browser points to the Management IP. Administrator can login to Remote Gateway through the VPN tunnel.

2.steps:

  Add a VPN policy on the firewall. choose main mode or aggressive mode 
  Select the Local network obtains IP addresses using DHCP through this VPN Tunnel radio button under Local Networks. 
Select the Choose destination network from list option and select the address object Central Net (LAN subnet on the Central site) under Destination Networks. 
  Check the HTTP /HTTPS check boxes for Management via this SA in the Advanced tab. 
  2) Open DHCP over VPN Configuration window on the VPN > DHCP over VPN page on the Remote Gateway and set parameters. 
  Enter Relay IP address and Management IP address. Those addresses must belong to the scope of LAN addresses of the Central Gateway. 
  3) Configure Central Gateway.
  Add a VPN policy on the firewall. choose main mode or aggressive mode 
  Select the Choose destination network from list option and select the address object LAN Primary Subnet under Local Networks.
  Select the Destination network obtains IP addresses using DHCP through this VPN Tunnel radio button under Destination Networks. 
  4) Open DHCP over VPN Configuration window on the VPN > DHCP over VPN page on the Central Gateway and set parameters. 
  Check on checkbox of "Send DHCP requests to the server addresses listed below" and add the IP address of external DHCP server.
  5) Configure the external DHCP server on the LAN of Central Gateway. Set the pool of addresses available for leasing. 
  6)  Let the DHCP Client have a lease.
  7) Make sure that the tunnel is not active and run ipconfig/release on the DHCP Client.
2.title: External server is used, Relay IP is specified on Remote Gateway, Management IP is set. Client releases a lease.
2.result:
1.When ipconfig/release runs on the DHCP Client, IKE negotiation is initiated by Remote Gateway and DHCP RELEASE packet is passed through the tunnel. 
  2.The DHCP Client's entry is removed from Current DHCP over VPN Leases table on Remote Gateway.
  3.Current DHCP over VPN Leases table on Central Gatewa y also shows two entries: Relay IP and Management IP.
  4.The message under the table on Remote and Central Gateways shows: The number of Dynamic: 0, Static: 2, Total: 2.
  5.Log message on Remote Gateway shows :DHCP RELEASE relayed to Central Gateway. message. Source : the DHCP Client?s address, destination: DHCP server on the Central site.
  6.Log message on Central Gatewa y shows :DHCP RELEASE is received from remote device.message. Source : Relay IP (that is specified on Remote Gateway), destination :the DHCP server?s address. ?

21.title: Static Devices on LAN, add.
21.result:

  When the PC on Remote network pings the Central network, the VPN tunnel is established.
  Current DHCP over VPN Leases table on Central Gateway shows two static entries, Relay IP address and the device with assigned static address.
  The message under the table shows: The number of Dynamic: 0, Static: 2, Total: 2.

23.title: Static Devices on LAN, delete.
23.result:
When IP address of static device is del eted from DHCP over VPN Configure dialog on Remote Gateway, the tunnel goes down.
  Current DHCP over VPN Leases table on Remote Gateway shows one static entry of Relay IP address.
  The message under the table shows: The number of Dynamic: 0, Static: 1, Total: 1.
